steps.title: Define Application Requirements for Elegant Calculator
steps.description: Outline the core functionality for the Elegant Calculator app, including basic arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division), clear, equals, and a numerical display.

steps.title: Set up Project Structure and Metadata for Elegant Calculator
steps.description: Configure the fundamental project metadata, including the app name 'Elegant Calculator' and package name 'com.elegantcalculator.app', ensuring consistency across all generated files.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest for Elegant Calculator
steps.description: Generate the AndroidManifest.xml, declaring the application's package, main activity (MainActivity), app label, and icon references. Ensure the correct Android namespace is used.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script for Elegant Calculator
steps.description: Create the app/build.gradle file, specifying the Android Gradle Plugin version, SDK versions (min 21, compile/target 34), build tools, and application ID. No external dependencies will be added.

steps.title: Design the User Interface Layout (activity_main.xml)
steps.description: Develop a modern and beautiful UI for the calculator using XML layout. This includes a display area (EditText) and a grid of buttons for numbers (0-9), operations (+, -, *, /), clear, equals, and decimal point.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity.java for Elegant Calculator
steps.description: Create the MainActivity.java file within the 'com.elegantcalculator.app' package. This class will extend Android's Activity and handle all UI interactions and calculator logic.

steps.title: Initialize UI Components in MainActivity
steps.description: Inside MainActivity.java, initialize references to the EditText display and all calculator buttons defined in activity_main.xml using findViewById.

steps.title: Implement Button Click Listeners for Elegant Calculator
steps.description: Attach OnClickListener instances to each number, operation, clear, equals, and decimal button. These listeners will update the calculator's state and display.

steps.title: Develop Calculator Logic in MainActivity
steps.description: Write the core arithmetic logic within MainActivity.java to handle number input, operation selection, and calculation execution. Manage the current number, previous number, and selected operator.

steps.title: Handle Decimal Point Input and Display Updates
steps.description: Implement logic to correctly add a single decimal point to numbers and update the EditText display in real-time as users input numbers and operations.

steps.title: Implement Clear and Equals Functionality
steps.description: Develop the 'C' button functionality to reset the calculator state and the '=' button functionality to trigger the final calculation and display the result.

steps.title: Ensure Java 8 Compatibility
steps.description: Verify that all Java code adheres to Java 8 syntax and features, avoiding newer constructs like lambdas or streams to ensure compatibility with the specified build environment.

steps.title: Building Elegant Calculator
steps.description: Finalizing the build process for the Elegant Calculator application using Gradle assembleDebug.
